info.title: AuditAE REST API
info.description: Check whether AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode) cite a brand, crawl a site, and generate or validate schema.org JSON-LD. Prepaid credit: paid calls draw from the workspace balance, free calls never do. When the balance is too low, a paid call answers 402 with a `top_up` request (POST /api/v1/billing/top-up). Authenticate with an ae_live_… key from https://auditae.app/dashboard/keys. The same tools are on the MCP server at https://auditae.app/api/mcp.

post.description: Asks each engine one prompt and reports whether the brand is cited. Runs synchronously within about 40 seconds; the fix-plan rows are written later. Needs at least 5¢ of credit to start.

engines.description: Engines to run. Omit for the defaults (chatgpt, perplexity, gemini, ai-overviews). Unknown names are dropped.

example.prompt: best project management tool for agencies

429.description: The workspace already has its maximum audits running (nothing started, nothing billed); retry in a minute. Or rate limited (see RateLimited).

post.x-auditae-price: Per engine: Perplexity 5¢, ChatGPT 7¢, Google AI Overviews 9¢, Google AI Mode 10¢ (opt-in), Gemini 12¢

post.description: Runs every prompt × engine cell synchronously (up to 300 seconds) and returns the results. When the workspace already has its maximum audits running, the audit is queued instead: 202, then poll GET /api/v1/audits/{id}. Each cell is billed as one check.

engines.description: Engines to run. Omit for the defaults (chatgpt, perplexity, gemini, ai-overviews). Unknown names are dropped.

prompts: best project management tool for agencies

report_url.description: Shareable report, once any cell completed.

202.description: Queued; starts when a slot opens.

429.description: The workspace is busy. Or rate limited (see RateLimited).

post.x-auditae-price: Per prompt × engine: Perplexity 5¢, ChatGPT 7¢, Google AI Overviews 9¢, Google AI Mode 10¢ (opt-in), Gemini 12¢

get.description: Fetches an audit this key's workspace ran, with every cell. Works at a zero balance.
Balance, per-engine check prices, estimated checks left and auto-refill status. Works at a zero balance.

post.description: Without a token, returns a Stripe Checkout URL for the account owner to pay. With a Stripe shared payment token (spt_…), charges it now and credits the workspace in the same request.

shared_payment_token.description: Stripe shared payment token to charge now.

200.description: A Checkout link, or the completed payment.

402.description: The payment token was declined, expired or deactivated.

502.description: Stripe didn't answer as expected. Check GET /api/v1/billing before paying again.

post.description: Crawls up to max_pages pages of a site in this workspace and reports technical issues. Needs credit for the worst case (max_pages × 1¢) up front; bills only the pages actually crawled.

site_id.description: A site in this workspace (see list_sites over MCP or the dashboard).

seed_url.description: Start page on the site's domain. Defaults to the homepage.

post.description: Fetches one page and reports meta tags, JSON-LD types, headings, robots.txt (including AI crawler blocks) and PageSpeed. Send `url` for an exact page or `domain` for its homepage.

url.description: Fetched as given; wins over domain.

post.description: Checks a JSON-LD object against the rules for its schema.org type and suggests optional properties.
Builds valid JSON-LD for a supported type from a few fields, and validates it.
Looks the brand up on Wikidata and returns its entity and the profile URLs to use as sameAs.

200.description: The entity, or candidates when none matched.

bearerAuth.description: An ae_live_… key from https://auditae.app/dashboard/keys. The same key works with the MCP server at https://auditae.app/api/mcp.

retry_after.description: Seconds to wait. Also sent as the Retry-After header.

PaymentRequired.description: The balance can't cover the call. Top up with the `top_up` request (it returns a Stripe Checkout URL for the account owner), then retry.

required_cents.description: Credit this call needs, in cents.

amount_usd.description: Suggested amount: the shortfall rounded up to whole dollars, within the top-up limits.

top_up_url.description: The billing page, for a person.

Engine.description: Answer engine. ai-mode is opt-in. Check prices: Perplexity 5¢, ChatGPT 7¢, Google AI Overviews 9¢, Google AI Mode 10¢ (opt-in), Gemini 12¢.

resolved_host.description: Real host behind an opaque redirect URL, when recovered.

brand_mentioned.description: The answer's text names the brand.

brand_url_cited.description: The brand's domain is among the answer's cited sources. Citation rate counts this.

raw_response.description: The engine's raw answer payload (shape varies by engine).

citation_rate.description: Share of answered cells that cite the brand's URL, 0–1.

partial.description: True when some cells didn't finish or failed.

out_of_credits.description: True when the run stopped because the balance ran out.

AuditResult.description: One stored cell, in the camelCase the audit store uses.

Audit.description: A stored audit. Field names are camelCase here, unlike the snake_case POST responses.

clickValue.description: Google Ads value of the prompts' keywords, in USD cents.

failureReason.description: Why the run stopped short, when it did.

reportUrl.description: Shareable report link once the audit is complete.

checkout_url.description: Stripe Checkout page for the account owner to pay.

balance_cents.description: New balance; null while the credit is pending.

note.description: Present when pending. Don't pay again.

billed_cents.description: 1¢ per page crawled; null if billing failed.

meta.description: Title, description, canonical, robots, viewport and Open Graph tags.

schema_types.description: JSON-LD @type values found on the page.

robots.description: robots.txt status, sitemaps and which AI crawlers it blocks.

same_as.description: Profile URLs for the Organization's sameAs.

BadRequest.description: The body is missing a field or has a bad value.

NotFound.description: Not found in this key's workspace.

ServerError.description: Something failed on our side. Safe to retry.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests: 60 per 60s per key, and 30 failed authentications per 60s per IP.

PaymentRequired.description: Not enough credit. The body says how much is short and how to top up.

top_up.note: Returns a Stripe Checkout URL. Give it to the account owner to pay; credit lands within seconds.
